item.title: Kerama Whale Watching — Guide
item.description: Every winter, from around January to March, humpback whales migrate to the warm waters around the Kerama Islands off Okinawa’s coast to breed and raise their calves, making this one of the best places in Japan for whale watching. Boat tours depart from Naha and the Kerama Islands (Tokashiki, Zamami and others) in search of these magnificent creatures, and sightings are common in season — with a high success rate at the height of the season.
